headline: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts on IR due to blood clot, expected to be out indefinitely
summary: The Eagles have placed Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after consultations with numerous doctors and experts, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

headline: Steelers place Wilson on IR with finger injury
summary: The Pittsburgh Steelers placed Roman Wilson on the injured reserve list, their second key receiver lost to injury in as many weeks.

headline: Jalen Hurts will go on injured reserve, miss at least four games and possibly more
summary: Hurts has a blood clot and will not play until Week 11 at the earliest.

headline: Patriots activate WR A.J. Brown for Sunday's game vs. Jets
summary: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown was activated from injured reserve Saturday after missing the past four games with a right high ankle sprain, the team announced.

headline: Taylor Moton among 3 Panthers activated ahead of Eagles game
summary: The Panthers will have RT Taylor Moton and DE Tershawn Wharton available Sunday against the Eagles. RB Trevor Etienne was also activated off IR.

headline: Reports: Caleb Williams to start for Bears Sunday
summary: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams was coy about his availability for Sunday's game against the Falcons during a Friday press conference, but he seemed to send a message with a social media post later in the day.
